text:
lina: Quick creative request for the launch push — need a small asset bundle by Tue EOD PT: 1) benchmark hero (1200x600) with two editable headline slots, 2) compact webinar signup modal (480x320) for docs, 3) three-frame social carousel (1080x1080) + a short vertical clip (9:16 ~15s). Keep strictly on-brand and accessible. cc @marc @pavan

marc: Got it. Please paste the primary + alt headlines and the figma link. Also confirm localization scope (JP/KO?).

lina: Primary: "Predictable LLM inference for production." Alt: "Lower unit cost, consistent latency." Figma: https://figma.com/file/launch_microkit_438
Localization: JP yes, KO no. Allow ~10% extra vertical space for JP headline.

pavan: Design note: we prefer an abstract sparkline panel on the hero (no raw numbers). Caption: "Representative benchmark across standard production GPUs." No chip/vendor names. Hero must support headline swaps without reflow.

claire: Legal: avoid absolute % claims or superlatives. Use language like "lower" or "reduced." I'll review final copy once drafts are up.

marc: I'll mock hero + modal today and upload frames by EOD. GIF/clip idea: animate sparkline + subtle CTA pulse, ease-in loop, target mp4 + gif fallback. Keep GIF fallback <2MB if feasible.

brandbot: Brand tokens: CTA color #FF3B30, type Inter, CTA weight 600. Provide high-contrast variant with 4.5:1 ratio. Motion token: short spring.

pavan: Analytics: need UTMs per headline variant and webinar_id param on modal CTA. Lina can you provide?

lina: UTMs: variant A: utm_campaign=launch_q3&utm_source=social&utm_variant=latency_first&utm_content=hero; variant B: utm_campaign=launch_q3&utm_source=social&utm_variant=cost_first&utm_content=hero. Webinar param: ?webinar_id=2026-06-14

marc: Uploading hero_v1 and modal_v1 to figma now. Frames include two headline text boxes for quick swaps and a static sparkline. Will add export checklist (png @2x, web jpgs, mp4 + gif).

claire: Accessibility: if using photo or gradient, apply 24% dark overlay to meet CTA contrast. Also include alt text file and a short motion description for the clip.

marc: Noted. JP copy request sent to localization; will allow taller headline box. I'll ping when GIF rough is in.

lina: Timeline recap: hero+modal drafts today, copy/legal review Mon, JP localization Tue morning, final assets Tue EOD PT. Thanks team — tag me when uploads are ready.

pavan: :thumbsup: Added myself to figma comment thread for analytics wiring. Link: https://figma.com/comments/mini-launch-438

legalbot: Reminder: do not reference specific hardware or make unverifiable performance claims in public assets.
